| Published      | 15 January 2026                                                               |
| Owners         | People Team (Chapters 1-12, 14-17); Product Documentation (Chapter 13)        |
| Classification | INTERNAL                                                                      |
| Applies to     | NorthStar Software (NSS), NorthStar Field Services (NSFS) and Shared Services |

All companies, people, products, addresses and figures in this document are fictional and were created for training purposes.

NorthStar Group was founded in 2009 as a small analytics consultancy and today operates through two operating companies and a shared services organisation. Our flagship product, Polaris, helps industrial customers collect sensor data, detect anomalies and plan maintenance. Polaris is offered as a cloud service (Polaris Cloud) and as an on-premises appliance (Polaris Edge).

The group headquarters is in Prague. Other offices are located in Lisbon, Krakow, Austin, Toronto and Singapore. Around 690 employees work for the group, excluding contractors.

text: About one week before your start date, the People Team sends you a welcome e-mail with your start time, office address and the name of your buddy. IT ships your laptop and accessories to your home address so that you can set up your accounts on day one. If you have not received the shipping notification three business days before your start date, reply to the welcome e-mail rather than opening an IT ticket, because you do not yet have portal access.

On your first day you collect your access badge at the reception of your office. Bring an official photo ID; the badge cannot be issued without it. The welcome session covers the company history, the Polaris products, the security basics and a short tour of the office. Field employees of NSFS additionally receive their safety equipment and a site safety briefing from the Site Safety Office.

Every new joiner is paired with a buddy from a different team. Buddies help with practical questions, introduce the new joiner to colleagues and meet with them regularly during the first six weeks. Buddies may spend up to two hours per week on buddy activities during this period. The buddy role is voluntary and is recognised in the performance review.

The standard working week is 40 hours for both entities. NSS uses flexible working time with core hours from 10:00 to 15:00 local time, during which employees are expected to be available for meetings. Outside the core hours, employees organise their time freely in agreement with their team.

NSFS uses shift-based working time for field and workshop roles. Office-based NSFS employees follow the NSS core hours.

All shifts include an unpaid 30-minute break, which must be taken after no more than six hours of work.
heading_path: 3. Working Time, Hybrid Work and Remote Work > 3.1 Working hours

text:
NSS employees may work remotely on up to two days per week. Tuesday is the mandatory in-office collaboration day for all NSS teams. Remote work must take place in the country of your employment contract; working from another country is covered by the Work from Anywhere rules in section 3.4.

Office-based NSFS employees may work remotely on one day per week. Field roles are not eligible for hybrid work because their work takes place at customer sites.

**Note:** Memos issued after publication may change these limits. Always check Chapter 16.
heading_path: 3. Working Time, Hybrid Work and Remote Work > 3.2 Hybrid work

text:
NSS employees are salaried and do not receive overtime pay. Extra hours approved by the manager can be compensated as time off in lieu at a ratio of 1:1, up to 16 hours per quarter. NSS engineers on the P1 on-call rotation receive an on-call allowance of 25 EUR per weekday night and 60 EUR per weekend or public-holiday day.

NSFS employees receive overtime pay of 150% of the hourly rate on weekdays and Saturdays, and 200% on Sundays and public holidays. NSFS on-call allowance is 40 EUR per weekday night and 90 EUR per weekend or public-holiday day. Call-outs are paid as overtime in addition to the allowance.
heading_path: 3. Working Time, Hybrid Work and Remote Work > 3.3 Overtime and on-call

text: Employees of both entities may work temporarily from another country for up to 20 working days per calendar year, with a maximum of 10 consecutive working days. Requests must be approved by the manager and the People Team at least 10 working days before the first day abroad. Work from Anywhere is not possible from countries on the group's sanctions list, and field roles of NSFS are not eligible. Unused days do not carry over to the next year.
heading_path: 3. Working Time, Hybrid Work and Remote Work > 3.4 Work from Anywhere (temporary work abroad)

text: Relocation means a permanent move to another country or office, usually linked to a new role. Relocation always requires a new or amended employment contract and is never handled through Work from Anywhere. NSS offers a relocation support package of up to 4,000 EUR covering moving costs, temporary housing for up to 30 days and one visa application. NSFS offers up to 2,500 EUR and does not cover temporary housing. Employees who resign within 12 months of relocation must repay 50% of the package.

text:
NSS employees receive 25 days of annual leave per calendar year; NSFS employees receive 23 days. In both entities, employees receive one additional day after 5 years of service and two additional days after 10 years of service. Leave is accrued pro rata for part-time employees and for employees who join or leave during the year.

NSS employees may carry over up to 5 unused days, which must be taken by 31 March of the following year. NSFS employees may carry over up to 3 unused days, which must be taken by 30 April of the following year. Carried-over days not taken by these dates expire.

Leave is requested in HR Hub. Requests for more than 3 consecutive days should be submitted at least two weeks in advance. Leave of more than 10 consecutive working days requires approval by both the manager and the head of department. NSFS has a leave blackout period from 1 to 15 December, when most customers schedule their annual maintenance shutdowns.

If you are ill, inform your manager before 09:00 (NSS) or before the start of your shift (NSFS). NSS employees may self-certify up to 3 consecutive days of sickness; NSFS employees may self-certify up to 2 consecutive days. A doctor's certificate is required from the following day. Sick leave during annual leave is converted back into sick leave only if a doctor's certificate is provided.

The primary caregiver receives 20 weeks of parental leave on full pay (NorthStar tops up any statutory benefit). The secondary caregiver receives 6 weeks on full pay. Parental leave applies equally to birth, adoption and surrogacy and must be taken within 12 months of the child's arrival. It may be split into a maximum of three blocks.

Volunteering leave allows employees to support registered charities for 2 days per year. Study leave covers exam days and exam preparation for courses approved by the manager. Bereavement leave applies to the loss of a family member. A moving day is granted once per year when you change your home address; it is not related to the relocation package in section 3.5.

All business trips are booked through the TripDesk travel portal after the manager has approved the trip. Bookings should be made at least 14 days before departure whenever possible. Rail is preferred over flights for journeys of less than four hours; first-class rail tickets are allowed for journeys of more than three hours.

Economy class is the standard for flights shorter than 6 hours. Premium economy is allowed for flights of 6 hours or longer. Business class requires prior approval by the CFO Office and is only considered for overnight flights longer than 10 hours.

Standard accounts require passwords of at least 14 characters; administrator accounts require at least 20 characters. Passphrases are encouraged. Passwords are changed only when a compromise is suspected, not on a fixed schedule. All passwords are stored in the company password manager, Keyvault.

Multi-factor authentication is mandatory for all accounts. Administrators and employees in Finance and the People Team must use hardware security keys; all others use the authenticator app.

NSS runs two review cycles per year: a mid-year review in July and a year-end review in January. NSFS runs one annual review in February, after the December maintenance season. Each review consists of a self-assessment, manager assessment, optional peer feedback and a calibration meeting within the department.

*Table: Performance rating scale*

|----------|--------------------------------|------------------------------------------------------------|

|        2 | Partially meeting expectations | Some goals met; development needed                         |
|        3 | Meeting expectations           | Solid performance in all key areas                         |
|        4 | Exceeding expectations         | Consistently above the requirements of the level           |
|        5 | Exceptional                    | Outstanding impact well beyond the role                    |

Career levels describe the scope and seniority of a role and are separate from performance ratings. NSS and Shared Services use levels L1 to L6. NSFS technical roles use technician grades T1 to T4; NSFS office roles use the L levels.

heading_path: 9. Performance and Career > 9.3 Promotions and internal moves

text:
NSS salaries are paid on the 25th of each month; if the 25th is not a business day, payment is made on the previous business day. NSFS salaries are paid on the 15th of the following month, together with overtime and allowances for the previous month.

NSS employees participate in an annual bonus with a target between 0% and 15% of base salary, depending on level, company results and individual rating. It is paid in March. NSFS employees receive a quarterly safety and productivity bonus of up to 6% of quarterly base salary; any lost-time safety incident in the crew reduces the bonus for that quarter to zero.
heading_path: 10. Compensation and Benefits > 10.1 Salary and bonus

text: Every employee has a personal learning budget of 1,200 EUR per calendar year for courses, conferences, books and certifications. Items above 500 EUR require manager approval. The budget resets on 1 January and unused amounts are not carried over. If an employee leaves within 12 months of a certification costing more than 1,000 EUR, the cost is repaid pro rata.

Every employee may claim up to 300 EUR per calendar year for gym memberships, sports equipment, sports courses and mental health apps. Claims are reimbursed quarterly and must be submitted by the 15th of the month following the end of the quarter. Unused amounts are not carried over.

| Mobile phone          | 20 EUR/month allowance for on-call engineers | Company smartphone (field roles)   |
| Referral bonus        | 2,000 EUR (engineering), 1,000 EUR (other)   | 1,000 EUR (all roles)              |

Referral bonuses are paid after the referred person has successfully completed probation. Managers cannot receive a referral bonus for hires into their own team.

Employees may accept gifts with a value of up to 50 EUR per gift, and no more than 150 EUR per year from the same business partner. Any gift worth more than 25 EUR must be recorded in the Gift Register within 5 business days. Cash and cash equivalents, such as vouchers, may never be accepted.

Gifts given to business partners may not exceed 75 EUR per recipient and must be recorded in the Gift Register regardless of value. No gifts or hospitality of any value may be offered to public officials.
heading_path: 11. Code of Conduct > 11.1 Gifts and hospitality

text: Potential conflicts of interest must be declared to Legal & Compliance within 14 days of becoming aware of them. Side jobs require prior written approval from the manager and the People Team; side jobs for competitors or customers are not approved.
section_title: 11.2 Conflicts of interest and side jobs
heading_path: 11. Code of Conduct > 11.2 Conflicts of interest and side jobs

text: Concerns about misconduct can be raised with the manager, the People Team, Legal & Compliance, or anonymously through the Speak-Up line. Reports are acknowledged within 7 days and the reporter receives feedback within 3 months. NorthStar does not tolerate retaliation against anyone who raises a concern in good faith.

Employees may mention that they work at NorthStar, but must not share INTERNAL, CONFIDENTIAL or RESTRICTED information, customer names or photos taken at customer sites. Only the Communications team speaks on behalf of the company.

Q: Can I carry over unused annual leave?
A: Yes, within limits. NSS employees may carry over up to 5 days until 31 March; NSFS employees up to 3 days until 30 April. See section 4.1.

Q: Can I carry over my unused learning budget?
A: No. The learning budget resets on 1 January. See section 10.2.

Q: Can I carry over unused volunteering days?
A: No. Volunteering leave is 2 days per year and expires at the end of the year.

Q: Can I carry over the wellness allowance?
A: No. Unused amounts expire at the end of the calendar year.

Q: I lost my laptop on the train. What do I do?
A: Report it immediately via the Security Hotline, at the latest within one hour. The hotline number is shown on the IT Service Portal.

Q: I lost my badge. What do I do?
A: Inform the reception of your office within 24 hours. A replacement fee applies, which differs by office (see Chapter 8).

Q: I lost a receipt. Can I still claim the expense?
A: Yes, with a Lost Receipt Declaration. The number of declarations per quarter is limited; see Figure 3.

Q: I missed the 30-day deadline for my expense claim.
A: Claims up to 90 days late can still be paid with additional approval from the cost-centre owner. Older claims are rejected.

Q: Can I work from Spain for a month?
A: Not in one block. Work from Anywhere allows a maximum of 10 consecutive working days and 20 working days per year.

Q: I am moving permanently to Lisbon. Is that Work from Anywhere?
A: No. A permanent move is a relocation and requires a new or amended contract. See section 3.5.

Q: I am moving to a new flat in the same city. Do I get a day off?
A: Yes, one moving day per year. This is unrelated to the relocation package.

Q: Can I bring my dog to the office?
A: Only in Lisbon, on Fridays, after registering in advance.

Q: What is the guest Wi-Fi?
A: Guest network names differ by office and are displayed on posters at reception. Employees must never connect work devices to a guest network.

Q: How do I book a meeting room?
A: Use SpaceFinder. Rooms with more than 8 seats can be booked for max. 2 hours between 10:00 and 15:00.

Q: Can I use public AI chatbots for my work?
A: Only with PUBLIC data. For INTERNAL and CONFIDENTIAL data, use NorthStar Assistant. RESTRICTED data may not be used with any AI tool.

Q: Am I paid for overtime?
A: NSS: no, but approved extra hours can be taken as time off in lieu. NSFS: yes, at 150% or 200%.

Q: When is my salary paid?
A: NSS on the 25th of the month; NSFS on the 15th of the following month.

Q: When is the referral bonus paid?
A: After the referred person has completed probation.

Q: A supplier sent me a bottle of wine worth 40 EUR. May I keep it?
A: Yes, it is below 50 EUR, but because it is worth more than 25 EUR you must record it in the Gift Register within 5 business days.

Q: May I invite a city official to lunch?
A: No. No gifts or hospitality may be offered to public officials.

Q: Do I need a purchase order for a 1,800 EUR purchase?
A: No, a company card or expense claim is enough. If it is software, it must still go through IT.

Q: Who approves an expense claim of 800 EUR?
A: See the approval flow in Figure 3.

Q: How many sick days can I take without a doctor's note?
A: NSS: up to 3 consecutive days. NSFS: up to 2.

Q: What is the difference between Polaris Cloud and Polaris Edge?
A: Polaris Cloud is the SaaS product operated by NSS. Polaris Edge is an appliance at the customer site, maintained by NSFS.

Q: Which Polaris Edge versions are supported?
A: The latest four minor versions.

Q: What is the P1 response time for a customer?
A: It depends on the plan. Standard: 4 hours. Premium: see Figure 9.

Q: Can I print a RESTRICTED document?
A: See the classification labels in Figure 8.

Q: Where are the first aid kits in the Prague office?
A: At reception and in the kitchen on the 3rd floor.

Q: Is P1 the same as a level 1 rating?
A: No. P1 is a support severity; ratings are 1 to 5; career levels are L1 to L6; technician grades are T1 to T4.

Q: How long are building access logs kept?
A: 1 year.
